html:
SMTO-SKL-0149 — Slack can't be used because Parameter Store is off

GUID: c31abbf4-67bb-57e3-8dda-f9c1d7405a7a
Slug: slack-parameter-store-required
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: slack

What happened

  • SMTO keeps your Slack app and workspace sign-in in Parameter Store, its place for saved settings and secrets. Parameter Store isn't available on this server, so SMTO can't reach Slack. Nothing was sent to Slack.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open the Parameter Store page from the navigation menu and check whether it opens and lists your saved entries. If Parameter Store is off, the page won't work and Slack can't find its saved sign-in.
  2. Ask the person who manages SMTO to turn Parameter Store on for this server and restart SMTO. Only someone who manages the server can change whether Parameter Store is on.
  3. Once the Parameter Store page shows your Slack entries, ask the Agent for the Slack request again. Nothing was sent to Slack, so it's safe to ask again once Parameter Store is back.

What success looks like

  • The Parameter Store page opens and the Agent can list your Slack workspaces.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't create Slack entries somewhere else as a workaround; Slack only reads them from Parameter Store.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The Slack provider could not be created because no Parameter Store instance is available in the execution context (for example AOR_AGENT_PARAMETER_STORE_ENABLED is false).

What this means

  • Slack provider construction receives no Parameter Store. The diagnostic performs no Slack request. Inspect the original receipt and operation stage to determine effects; keep workspace, principal and exact channel/message identities fixed during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • Slack provider construction receives no Parameter Store.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the provider's service context and configured profile store.

How to fix it

  • provider_for with no provider is raised when the execution context carries no AgentParameterStore or MemoryParameterStore. Make sure AOR_AGENT_PARAMETER_STORE_ENABLED is unset or true in the Server environment, restart the Server, then confirm the Parameter Store page loads and holds the Slack OAuth App and Slack Workspace records.
  • Enable the existing Parameter Store before configuring Slack authorization.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect exact provider state and authority first.

How to verify the fix

  • A supported runtime supplies Parameter Store before Slack authorization.

What not to do

  • Do not expose secrets or blindly replay uncertain mutations.

Technical notes

  • The diagnostic performs no Slack request. Inspect the original receipt and operation stage to determine effects; keep workspace, principal and exact channel/message identities fixed during recovery.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
